_description: Output schema for the SSRF triager. The agent reads this file alongside SKILL.md and emits triage-output.json conforming to this shape. category: When triage_decision is TRUE POSITIVE: one of: PATH TRAVERSAL | HOST CONTROL | OPEN REDIRECT. When triage_decision is FALSE POSITIVE: one of: QUERY PARAMETER | MITIGATED | MISMATCH | TEST CODE. When triage_decision is UNCLEAR: exactly 'N/A'.
